summary: Keep live and deleted task lists separate during startup.
category: fix
dev: Include filtering and cursor policy in the existing slim-list memo key.

replacements:
const memoKey = [
        includeArchived ? "all" : "active",
        columnFilter ?? "*",
        options?.columns?.join(",") ?? "*",
        options?.excludeColumns?.join(",") ?? "*",
        options?.sort ?? "created-asc",
      ].join(":");
